content: Browser tic-tac-toe games commonly ship: 3 AI difficulty levels (Easy=random moves, Medium=tactical win/block heuristics, Hard=minimax/unbeatable), live score tracking (wins per side + draws), round/match counters, hover and win animations (confetti, blink, highlight), custom player names for local multiplayer, and responsive/themed (neon, glassmorphism) UI. Local PvP + PvAI are the two standard modes; online multiplayer appears in a minority of hobby projects.
